# Validation

```{r model_family_header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_header(
  family = "vesm",
  pages = c(
    Overview = "index.html",
    Theory = "vesm-theory.html",
    Implementation = "vesm-implementation.html",
    Benchmarks = "vesm-benchmarks.html",
    Validation = "vesm-validation.html"
  )
)
```

VESM is checked on layered gas-core elastic-shell spheres with radial FEM/modal references over frequency, radius, layer, shell, and viscous-parameter coverage.

::: {.tip data-title="Residuals near nulls"}
Mean absolute differences describe the typical agreement; maximum differences are retained because deep nulls can expose localized convention or resolution errors.
:::
